_meta.title: Compatibility compare/contrast cards (Shared/Different/Watch/Try)
_meta.note: Sign trait clauses condensed from Marie Satori, 'As Above, So Below' (2023) — her verbatim per-sign Moon/Mercury/Venus descriptions — plus cc-planet-in-sign-reviewed. Voiced-original condensations of her words; tier voiced-original-grounded, DRAFT pending sign-off. NOT served as verbatim Marie.

aries.function: The Moon rules your emotions, your intuition, and the subconscious. It shows how each of you feels, soothes, and needs care.
aries.nouns: emotional needs, comfort habits, private reactions
aries.shared: You share the same emotional language, so you recognize each other fast.
aries.different: You both feel fast and fiery, quick to act on a mood — the risk is a shared blind spot, not a clash.
aries.watch: You can amplify the same mood instead of balancing each other out.
aries.try: When you're both low, let one of you name it out loud first.

taurus.function: The Moon rules your emotions, your intuition, and the subconscious. It shows how each of you feels, soothes, and needs care.
taurus.nouns: emotional needs, comfort habits, private reactions
taurus.shared: You both need to feel safe — you just reach for it differently.
taurus.different: Aries feels fast and fiery and wears its heart on its sleeve; Taurus feels deeply and grounds in comfort, stability, and the senses.
taurus.watch: Your timing for comfort can be off — one soothes while the other wants to move on.
taurus.try: Say what would actually settle you instead of assuming the other knows.

gemini.shared: You both need to feel safe — you just reach for it differently.
gemini.different: Aries feels fast and fiery and wears its heart on its sleeve; Gemini feels in quick, changeable shifts and needs to talk it out.
gemini.watch: The ease can let you skip saying what you actually need.
gemini.try: Keep naming what you need even when things feel smooth.
